title: when a brief fails several checks they are reported as one line in the order sections, length, language, paths

stderr.regex: (?m)JITSO REJECTED: brief failed: sections \(missing section: Scope, Done when, Report format\); length \(\d+ words, expected 40 to 800\); language \(the brief must be written in English\); paths \(cited path does not exist: src/ghost/x\.ts\)\. A file the worker will create goes on a line that starts with Output: or Creates:$
